description_en: Installs backup clients on one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 为一台或者多台ECS实例安装备份客户端
name: InstallBackupClients

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances. You can specify a maximum of 20 instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of cross-account backup. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Backs up data within the current account.

CROSS_ACCOUNT: Backs up data across accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account that is used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份功能中的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role that is created in the source account for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 用于跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates that the operation is successful

InstanceStatuses.description_en: The status of the ECS instances

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:

An empty value indicates that the operation is successful.

InstanceNotExists: The ECS instance does not exist.

InstanceNotRunning: The ECS instance is not in the Running state.

CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance: Cloud Assistant is not available
ErrorCode.description_zh:
返回错误码。取值范围：

空表示成功。
InstanceNotExists表示ECS实例不存在。
InstanceNotRunning表示ECS实例未处于Running状态。
CloudAssistNotRunningOnInstance表示云助手不可用

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

ValidInstance.description_en:
Indicates whether a backup client can be installed on the ECS instance.

true: The backup client can be installed.

false: The backup client cannot be installed
ValidInstance.description_zh:
ECS实例是否可以安装备份客户端。

true表示可以安装。
false表示不可以安装

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the request is successful, successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful.

true: The request is successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. Call the DescribeTask operation to query the task result
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
